desc: Add members to an existing organizational usergroup. This method is only available to Enterprise Grid organizations.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

id.desc: ID of the usergroup to add users to

users.desc: The encoded user IDs to add to the usergroup, provided as a JSON array or a comma-separated string.

error.desc: A string representation of the error type

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Admin APIs feature is not enabled for this workspace.

invalid_auth.desc: The workspace specified is not part of this organization.

restricted_action.desc: The calling user cannot modify the specified usergroup, or the usergroup's membership is managed by an identity provider (IdP) and can only be changed through SCIM.

not_an_enterprise.desc: The token passed in does not belong to an Enterprise organization.

invalid_usergroup.desc: A usergroup with the specified ID does not exist.

invalid_users.desc: One or more users provided can not be added to the usergroup.

user_not_found.desc: One or more users provided are invalid or are not a member of the organization.

member_count_would_exceed_visible_limit.desc: The usergroup is visible and the member count would exceed the limit.

cannot_modify_role_admin.desc: The user does not have permission to modify the roles admin role.
